officialRef.pdf: 初一第3辑初中时文阅读提分训练3+X第3辑7年级答案.pdf

q1.explanationZh: 第一段说海豹妈妈在沙滩上生下宝宝，第二段说为了保护它们，官员把这片沙滩封起来了。

evidence.quote: To protect Kaiwi and her newborn baby, Hawaiian officials have closed off the beach where they are resting.

q2.explanationZh: 第一段写明海豹妈妈和宝宝会在沙滩上待大约两个月，直到宝宝能独立生活。

evidence.quote: She and her baby seal will stay on the beach for about two months.

q3.explanationZh: 后文说这种海豹不到1600只，官员还要保护它们，所以 endangered 是“濒危的”，也就是有灭绝的危险。

evidence.quote: There are fewer than 1,600 of them living in the world today.

q4.explanationZh: 第二段说守卫日夜巡逻，目的是 to ensure their safety，也就是保证海豹母子的安全。

q5.explanationZh: 全文讲的是人们封海滩、设围栏、派守卫来保护濒危的僧海豹母子，所以选 D。

evidence.quote: Many people feel happy to see the mother seal and her baby being protected in their natural home.
